definitions.gloss: Lego; interlocking plastic building blocks (brand name)
definitions.explanation: A brand of colorful interlocking plastic construction blocks made by the Danish company Lego. In Japanese, the full term レゴブロック (Lego blocks) is also used. One of the world's most popular toys.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がレゴで{城|しろ}を{作|つく}っている。
examples.english: The child is building a castle with Lego.

examples.japanese: レゴブロックは{小|ちい}さな{部品|ぶひん}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせてさまざまな{形|かたち}を{作|つく}れる{玩具|がんぐ}だ。
examples.english: Lego bricks are a toy that lets you combine small pieces to create all sorts of shapes.

notes:
A loanword from the Danish brand name Lego, derived from the phrase "leg godt" (play well). In Japanese contexts レゴブロック (Lego blocks) is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レゴで{遊|あそ}ぶ: to play with Lego
- レゴを{組|く}み{立|た}てる: to assemble Lego
- レゴブロック: Lego blocks
- レゴセット: Lego set
